```{r, message=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)

library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(knitr)
library(data.table)
library(cowplot)

library(pheatmap)

library(future)
options("future.globals.maxSize"=2**33)
plan("multicore", workers = 4)

result_folder = "../../../../Results/Zhang_scRNA/"
if (!file.exists(result_folder)) dir.create(result_folder, recursive=T)

data_storage_folder = "../../../../Data/ExtData/Zhang_scRNA"
if (!file.exists(data_storage_folder)) dir.create(data_storage_folder, recursive=T)

rerun_dge_analyses = T
```

```{r}
data_file_epi = file.path(data_storage_folder, "Zhang_epi_only.Rdata")
reprocess_data = F
if(reprocess_data) {
  load(file.path(data_storage_folder, "Zhang_all_cells_CCA.RData"))
  meta <- readRDS(file.path(data_storage_folder, "Zhang_all_cells_CCA_metadata.rds"))
  scData.combined@meta.data <- meta[Cells(scData.combined), ]
  old = scData.combined
  
  all_clusters = unique(old$cluster_label)
  selected_clusters = all_clusters[grepl("Metaplastic|G-cell|Gland base|Goblet|Pit cell|EEC", all_clusters)]
  selected_samples = unique(old$label)
  selected_samples = selected_samples[grepl("Non-atrophic|Chronic|Mild|Severe", selected_samples)] # exclude cancer sample
  set.seed(20230808)
  scData.combined = subset(old, cluster_label %in% selected_clusters & label %in% selected_samples)
  rm(old)
  tmp = DietSeurat(scData.combined)
  gc()
  DefaultAssay(scData.combined) <- "integrated"
  set.seed(1234)
  cData.combined <- ScaleData(scData.combined, verbose = TRUE, vars.to.regress = c("percent_mito"))
  gc()
  scData.combined <- FindVariableFeatures(scData.combined, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
  scData.combined <- RunPCA(scData.combined, npcs = 30, verbose = TRUE)
  #gc()
  scData.combined <- RunUMAP(scData.combined, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:15)
  scData.combined <- FindNeighbors(scData.combined, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:15)
  scData.combined <- FindClusters(scData.combined, resolution = 0.3)
  gc()
  save(scData.combined, file=data_file_epi, compress=T)
  
} else {
  load(data_file_epi)
}
```

```{r}
plot_top_genes <- function(data, dge_results_all, title) {
  for (n in sort(unique(dge_results_all$cluster))) {
    tmp = subset(dge_results_all, cluster==n)
    if(nrow(tmp)<1) next
    tmp_up = subset(tmp, avg_log2FC > 0)
    if(nrow(tmp_up)<1) next
    tmp_up$direction = "up"
    #tmp_down = subset(tmp, avg_log2FC < 0)
    #tmp_down$direction = "down"
    
    #final_top_genes = rbind(head(tmp_up,10), head(tmp_down,10))
    final_top_genes = head(tmp_up, 10)
    final_top_genes = final_top_genes[order(final_top_genes$avg_log2FC),]
    final_top_genes$gene = factor(final_top_genes$gene, levels = final_top_genes$gene)
    p = ggplot(final_top_genes, aes(y=avg_log2FC, x=gene, fill=direction)) + geom_bar(stat="identity") + ggtitle(paste0(n, ", ", title)) + coord_flip() + theme(axis.text.y =  element_text(size=12) )
    print(p)
    
  }
}
```

```{r}

plot_genes <- function(dataset, genes, split.by=NULL) {

  all_genes =rownames(dataset@assays$RNA)

  for (g in sel_markers) {
    if (!g %in% all_genes) {
      print(paste0("Gene ",g," has no data (possibly filtered out)."))
      next
    } else {
        p1  =FeaturePlot(object = dataset, features = g, reduction="umap", split.by=split.by, label=T)
        p2 = VlnPlot(dataset, features = g, ncol = 1, pt.size = 0.01, split.by = split.by) #+ NoLegend()
        if (is.null(split.by)) {
          print(plot_grid(p1,p2, ncol=2,align="h"))
        } else {
          print(plot_grid(p1,p2, ncol=1,align="v"))
        }

    }
  }
}
```


# Marker exploration

## Selection markers and markers of epithelial and contaminating cells

These are markers used in the cell sorting to select cells for scRNA analysis. Cells were sorted as Lgr5+ eGFP cells from Lgr5-EGFP-IRES-CreER(T2) mice. Since eGFP will be expresed in the offspring of cells positive for Lgr5 at the time of Cre induction, we would expect mainly epithelial cells to be selected.

We here also include markers that should be negative (Cd45 (Ptprc), Cd34, Vim, Myh11) but might be positive in contaminating cells.



```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
sel_markers=c("LGR5","AXIN2","EPCAM","PTPRC","CD34","VIM", "MYH11", "ASCL2")
DefaultAssay(scData.combined) <- "RNA"

#plot_genes(scData.combined, sel_markers)
DotPlot(scData.combined, features = sel_markers, cols="RdYlBu", assay="RNA")
```



## Epithelial subgroup markers

Cd44, Sox2, Lgr5 - Lgr5+ signature  
Muc6 - gland base cells  
Gast, Ghrl, Chga - G-cells  
Dclk1 - Tuft cells  
LIPF - Chief cells  
Pgc, Gif  - Chief cells
Tff1 (stomach surface), Tff2 - pan stomach epithelial cell markers  
Tff3 - intestinal (goblet cell) marker  
FABP1 - intestinal differentiated cells  
ATP4A,ATP4B - Parietal  

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
sel_markers=c("CD44","SOX2","LGR5","MUC6","MUC5AC","GKN1","GKN2","GAST","GHRL","CHGA","PGC","GIF","MUC2", "DCLK1", "TFF1","TFF2","TFF3","FABP1", "LIPF", "ATP4A","ATP4B","KRT19")

#plot_genes(scData.combined, sel_markers)
DotPlot(scData.combined, features = sel_markers, cols="RdYlBu", assay="RNA") + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1))
```
